description: A sign-up in steps with a progress bar or a list of steps; back and next move between them.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A sign-up in steps: the progress, the fields of the current step, back and next. `current` is the step shown,
  counted from 1. Axes: progress (bar, list: every step named), layout (card, plain). Keeping the typed values
  between steps is the page's job.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { WizardStep, WizardLabels } from "./signup-wizard.types";

export type SignupWizardProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  steps: WizardStep[];
  labels: WizardLabels;
  current?: number;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  progress?: "bar" | "list";
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Input from "../compose/Input.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Progress from "../compose/Progress.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  steps,
  labels,
  current = 1,
  level = 2,
  progress = "bar",
  layout = "card",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SignupWizardProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ go: [step: number] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block v-if="((steps?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
    tag="section"
    :class="cn(
      'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-lg flex-col gap-6 px-4 py-8',
      (((layout as string) === 'card') ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border' : '')
    )"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl('{0}-title', id))"
    data-testid="wizard"
    :data-current="(current == null ? undefined : String(current))"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Title :as="level" size="2xl" weight="bold" :id="tpl('{0}-title', id)">
      {{ title }}
    </Title>
    <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground" data-testid="step-of">
      {{ tpl(labels.stepOf, current, (steps?.length ?? 0)) }}
    </Text>
    <Progress v-if="((progress as string) === 'bar')"
      :value="(current == null ? undefined : String(current))"
      :max="((steps?.length ?? 0) == null ? undefined : String((steps?.length ?? 0)))"
      :aria-label="labels.steps"
    />
    <List
      v-if="((progress as string) === 'list')"
      class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0"
      :aria-label="labels.steps"
      data-testid="step-list"
    >
      <ListItem v-for="(s, i) in steps" :key="s.id"
        :class="cn(
          'flex items-center gap-4 text-sm',
          (((i + 1) === current) ? 'font-semibold' : 'text-muted-foreground')
        )"
        :aria-current="(((i + 1) === current) ? 'step' : undefined)"
        data-testid="step-item"
      >
        <LucideIcon :name="(((i + 1) < current) ? 'circle-check' : s.icon)" :size="16" />
        {{ s.title }}
      </ListItem>
    </List>
    <template v-for="(s, i) in steps" :key="s.id">
      <Stack v-if="((i + 1) === current)" gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="step">
        <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
          {{ s.title }}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ s.text }}
        </Text>
        <Box class="grid gap-4">
          <Field :label="s.fieldA" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-a', id)">
            <Input type="text" :name="tpl('{0}-a', id)" :id="tpl('{0}-a', id)" data-testid="field" />
          </Field>
          <Field :label="s.fieldB" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-b', id)">
            <Input type="text" :name="tpl('{0}-b', id)" :id="tpl('{0}-b', id)" data-testid="field" />
          </Field>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </template>
    <Group gap="2" justify="between">
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="default"
        type="button"
        :disabled="(current < 2)"
        data-testid="wizard-back"
        @click="() => emit('go', (current - 1))"
      >
        {{ labels.back }}
      </Button>
      <Button
        variant="default"
        size="default"
        type="button"
        data-testid="wizard-next"
        @click="() => emit('go', (current + 1))"
      >
        {{ ((current >= (steps?.length ?? 0)) ? labels.finish : labels.next) }}
      </Button>
    </Group>
  </Block>
</template>
